name: phase-1-idle
prompt:
Edit the referenced established videogame character into a production sprite animation sheet, transparent background. Exact same young adult female lavender-haired two-cone Harlequin, long flowing wavy lavender hair, youthful anime-cartoon face, dark teal and purple two-cone cap with gold bells, gold cream ruff, dark teal/purple diamond patterned tunic and baggy trousers, white gloves, purple curled boots, black staff with gold crescent. Preserve her approved character identity and compact anime-cartoon anatomy across ALL images. NO short bob, no older face, no taller adult body, no different outfit. Two arms and two legs only. All characters face LEFT. Four genuinely hand-drawn successive animation cels in a clean 2x2 equal grid, all at the EXACT SAME camera distance and anatomical scale. Each cell contains ONE complete whole-body sprite with comfortable alpha padding on ALL sides; NO cropping of staff, bells, hat, boots or hair. Repeat the SAME physical pose with subtle clear progressive hair waves, fabric movement and breathing/effort; don't create four unrelated poses. The upper left and lower right should smoothly loop through the other drawings. Sharp saturated clean high quality anime-cartoon shading and bold contours matching the references. No text, labels, panels, floor, shadows, FX, auras or luminous fringes. Magic will be drawn by the engine.
PHASE EXPRESSION: calm playful confidence: regular magenta eyes, relaxed small mischievous closed smile. Her hair is just as long and abundant as in the manic reference; do not make her younger or change face structure.
POSE: Standing poised on both boots, three-quarter view facing left, torso upright, crescent staff held diagonally toward the left in her front hand, free gloved hand relaxed near waist. A coherent 4-frame idle loop: hair and hat tips slowly sweep to the right and back, subtle chest breath and glove flex. Grounded stance, feet fixed at the same baseline, head at same height.
